title: Exchange of letters between the Governor and the Chancellor on the Asset Purchase Facility - November 2026

refs.t: Exchange of letters between the Governor and the Chancellor on the Asset Purchase Facility - November 2026

sum: The Bank of England exchanged letters with the Governor and the Chancellor on the Asset Purchase Facility, which is a program to buy financial assets to support the economy. This happened in November 2026.
